assets.name: forest-greenery
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent background scenery layer for Size Em Up!, a playful illustrated mobile game. Rounded cartoon forms, gentle hand-painted shading, muted pastel colors, soft color-matched outlines. Quiet low-contrast scenery behind much bolder measured objects. Wide landscape composition. Genuine transparent alpha outside the subjects. No text, numbers, watermark, checkerboard, people, animals or foreground measured objects. A dense continuous bank of layered woodland greenery: rounded sage and muted fern-green bushes beneath overlapping tall leafy tree canopies, a few soft trunks visible. Trees and bushes fill a wide strip with a level bottom baseline, top silhouette uneven. Atmospheric depth, farther greenery paler. No ground or sky painted; transparent above and around the silhouette. Plants rooted on bottom baseline, not separate floating leaves.
